label: Individual deletion fails at some world accessible from the selected world
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: it is not the case that at every world v accessible from the selected world w, every concrete individual existing at v is absent from some world accessible from v. Equivalently (classically), some world possible relative to w has a concrete individual necessary relative to that world in the world-relative sense. It does not say that this individual exists at w or at every world accessible from w.
